role: Sealed independent A first source/operator/scope verdicts
reviewBasis: Neutral entry and its exact retained inputs only; no peer comparison

rows.operatorJudgement: E1/E2/E3: identify a chemically investigable question and formulate a theory-led testable hypothesis; derive a prediction and condition a counter-result.
rows.materialJudgement: The equilibrium case is a suitable GA12 LB7 context. The weak-acid case is an authored contextualisation, not an added compulsory GA12 acid-content claim.
rows.remainingBoundary: Only C12-GA.1.8 question/hypothesis work is supported. No performed investigation, C11 duty, EA/J13 or national-context clearance.

rows.operatorJudgement: E4/E5 experimental branch: hypothesis-guided qualitative AND quantitative planning, actual safe execution and own transparent protocol.
rows.materialJudgement: Both cases require own plan, substance/instrument authorisation and actual observations. A supplied hypothesis permits this experimental contribution; generating one is a separately assessed operator.
rows.remainingBoundary: C12-GA.1.9 retains experiment OR model-based hypothesis testing. This child cannot turn that OR into a compulsory pair. The GA12-specific LB3/LB8 experimental duties and all original partners remain.

rows.operatorJudgement: S17 mathematical evaluation, bounded E6 digital calculation/evaluation, E8/E11 interpretation and interdisciplinary hypothesis relation.
rows.materialJudgement: The calibration and kinetics cases require an actual spreadsheet, justified mathematical method and scope-limited interpretation. Supplied synthetic values are explicitly not learner measurements.
rows.remainingBoundary: C12-GA.1.10 also contains acquisition, representation, modelling and simulation operators; these are not all cleared by a calculation file. Calibration/first-order examples add no compulsory GA12 content clause.

rows.operatorJudgement: B3: assess suitability, limitations and reach of information/data using stated controls and conditions.
rows.materialJudgement: Both complete cases constrain unsupported concentration/identity inferences and distinguish repeat scatter from full uncertainty.
rows.remainingBoundary: This is C12-GA.1.27 data/information validity only. It grants no LB3.3 analytic-test clearance, no completed ion proof and no removal of the source/inquiry-reflection partners.

rows.operatorJudgement: E10: reflect on own results and own inquiry process.
rows.materialJudgement: The cases require original own execution/raw/action records before reflection. A guided investigation may be one's own without falsely attributing supplied planning decisions to the learner.
rows.remainingBoundary: No actual prior receipt is supplied. E12 five-criterion scientific-validity reflection is distinct; it cannot substitute for E10 ownership. No lower-stage or full original-family clearance.

rows.operatorJudgement: E12: apply reproducibility, falsifiability, intersubjectivity, logical consistency and provisionality to findings and inquiry limits.
rows.materialJudgement: Both complete cases actually apply all five criteria; reliable matching counterevidence is distinguished from failed measurement and a non-equilibrium reading.
rows.remainingBoundary: The normative five-item requirement is GA12 upper-secondary evidence only here. No universal lower-stage requirement and no whole source/family approval.

rows.operatorJudgement: K1/K2/K8/K12: own analogue/digital research and purposeful selection, complex-information interpretation and conclusions, authorship/citations/quotations.
rows.materialJudgement: The tasks require checkable own retrieval and actual additional accessible scientific reading. The six-document archive distinguishes model data from measurements and policy from material balance.
rows.remainingBoundary: No learner retrieval or additional external reading is supplied. Pharmaceutical Q is hypothetical; it is not a compulsory claim from GA12 LB1. Presentation remains a separate performance.

rows.operatorJudgement: K3/K4: compare source/representation claims and trustworthiness; B2/B4 additionally requires independently procured sources, relevance and author intent.
rows.materialJudgement: The existing supplied-source cases support K3/K4. The new complete b2-own-retrieval-source-criticism task supplies the missing B2 procurement condition with own search/selection/reading records, not preselected relevant sources.
rows.remainingBoundary: B2 own procurement is route-specific. Do not count the two supplied-source cases alone as B2 and do not invent a universal research prerequisite for all source criticism. Same-model A/B agreement is not independent experiment evidence.

rows.operatorJudgement: B10/B12/B13: social/ecological significance and historical/current impacts of products, methods, processes and knowledge, three sustainability perspectives and own action.
rows.materialJudgement: Both cases keep the product/method/process/knowledge union, historical/current context, ecological/economic/social conflicts and realistic own-action reflection.
rows.remainingBoundary: Authored indicators are not a full real lifecycle assessment. Historical citations are retained references, not newly verified external historical-source evidence in this restricted review. Original action-option/context partners stay.

rows.operatorJudgement: S8/S15 dynamic equilibrium distinction, E4/E5 model alternative, bounded E6 actual digital modelling/calculation, E7 selection/use of models and E9 model limitations.
rows.materialJudgement: The new ga-dynamic-equilibrium-model-use task correctly gives 50/50 with 10/10 continuing transitions and 60/40 to 56/44 to 53.6/46.4, conserved total 100. Fractional counts are expectations; products must be the learner's own.
rows.remainingBoundary: This adds only named GA12 components. It is not a performed experiment, full catalyst/influence-factor duty, complete C12-GA.1.4/.10, or the whole atom/PSE/bonding/complex-molecule/receptor/enzyme context union. Existing whole cases stay distinct.

rows.operatorJudgement: K5/K6/K7/K9: purposeful preparation/transformation, correct scientific/everyday language, audience/situation and representation reflection.
rows.materialJudgement: Both complete cases require an actual new representation, correct reference quantities and a justified preserved/limited statement. A grade-8 audience does not classify the presenting learner's curriculum stage.
rows.remainingBoundary: This is the C12-GA.1.19 transformation component; copying a text is insufficient. Original symbol/language partners and other source occurrences remain. A specific molecule-formula goal cannot replace the full obligation.

rows.operatorJudgement: K11: actually present chemical subject matter AND own learning/work results using appropriate analogue AND digital media.
rows.materialJudgement: Both cases require own prior work, real delivery, both media and audience/moderator records; structure and medium choices are justified.
rows.remainingBoundary: No presentation or listener response has occurred in this packet. An own laboratory experiment is not universally required for this presentation operator. Prepared slides or a reference talk do not establish performance.

wholeScopeHoldFindings.operator: dynamic equilibrium AND influence factors on substance/particle levels including catalysts
wholeScopeHoldFindings.finding: The dynamic two-state witness covers the static/dynamic distinction only; it does not clear all original partners or the full influence-factor/catalyst clause.
wholeScopeHoldFindings.remedy: Retain the full original row and six partner edges; independently review every remaining component in its actual source/content context before any whole-row change.

wholeScopeHoldFindings.finding: No ordinary projection, alternative-route or atlas integration is authorised by a list of partial edge proposals. One model or calculation product cannot clear all operators or convert the explicit OR into AND.
wholeScopeHoldFindings.remedy: Integrate only through a separately reviewed occurrence-specific ordinary route/target model that preserves alternatives, original partners and unfinished whole duties.

wholeScopeHoldFindings.finding: The supplementary task validly requires own retrieval but supplies no performed retrieval. Supplied-source cases alone remain insufficient for a B2 performance claim.
wholeScopeHoldFindings.remedy: Keep the source-specific retrieval condition bound to the B2 route; require the actual retrieval/reading product before claiming a learner performed it. This is not an extra human gate for machine material review.

wholeScopeHoldFindings.operator: own inquiry/results; actual presentation of subject matter and own work using both media
wholeScopeHoldFindings.finding: Authored tasks and protocols are available but no own investigation or presentation was performed. Inactive children and pending native bindings yield no current strict completion.
wholeScopeHoldFindings.remedy: Preserve truthful material-only status and inactive child state. Complete separate native D/P/A/M/V and authorised ordinary integration before claiming current strict coverage; require actual receipts before learner-performance claims.
